watchdog_regression.diagnosis: Watchdog asserted after the route timer scan, during physical keyboard delivery. Two bounded RX checks and full IRQ return/re-entry delayed service to 100.298994 us. Payload, native cleanup and byte deadlines passed; the original 100 us watchdog gate rejected the run.
watchdog_regression.fix: Console service checks at most one enabled pending watchdog after RX, both before its wake post and before IRQ return. No loop, state, ABI or bank-zero reservation added. The complete matrix, TX and real fault responders must be rebuilt and rerun.
watchdog_regression.evidence_scope: Preserved pre-fix observation from slice 8, not a passing qualification or a modified trace.
